rationale: The stock has already recovered sharply from the open gap-down ($54.99 open to $57.86 last, now at 84.8% of today's range and near today's high of $58.38), meaning the easy directional move has largely played out. The negative earnings surprise (EPS miss of -250%) creates overhead resistance near prior close ($58.86), while the strong intraday recovery argues against a fresh short. With price extended above VWAP ($56.59) and the 9-EMA ($55.75) by a wide margin after a rapid 5-candle surge, the risk/reward for either direction is unfavorable at this moment — chasing the long risks buying the top of a volatile open, and shorting into momentum with a negative-news catalyst already partially digested is equally risky.
